description: Work out what a seller walks away with when selling a property: cash proceeds after redeeming the outstanding loan, refunding each owner’s CPF (principal plus accrued interest, 1 to 4 owners), and paying agent commission (with 9% GST), legal and miscellaneous fees. Flags a negative sale when the deductions exceed the selling price.

agentFeePercent.description: Agent commission as a share of the selling price, as a percentage (e.g. 1.5 = 1.5%, not 0.015), before the 9% GST added on top.

legalFees.description: Conveyancing fees for the sale, deducted from the proceeds, in SGD.

miscellaneousFees.description: Other selling costs (repairs, valuation, admin), in SGD.

outstandingLoanAmount.description: Home loan still owed, repaid from the sale on completion, in SGD.

owners.description: CPF usage per owner (1 to 4 owners). Include every owner; use zeros for an owner who used no CPF.

cpfAccruedInterest.description: Accrued interest owed to this owner's CPF account on the CPF used, in SGD.

cpfUtilised.description: CPF principal this owner used for the property (downpayment, instalments, stamp duty), in SGD.

sellingPrice.description: Price the property sells for, in SGD; every deduction comes out of it.

name: calculate_sales_proceeds

agentFees.description: Agent commission including 9% GST, in SGD.

cashProceeds.description: Cash left for the sellers after all deductions, in SGD. Negative means a negative sale: the sellers must top up cash to complete.

isNegativeSale.description: True when cash proceeds are negative.

owners.description: Per-owner CPF refunds, in input order.

cpfRefund.description: Refund to this owner's CPF account (principal utilised plus accrued interest), in SGD.

perBankProceeds.description: Per-bank bridging headroom from the sale, when bank rules are supplied. Omitted otherwise.

cash.description: Cash headroom the bank allows from the sale, in SGD.

monthlyInterest.description: Interest-only monthly instalment on the total headroom, in SGD.

total.description: Total bridging headroom (cash + CPF), in SGD.

totalCpfRefund.description: Total refunded to all owners' CPF accounts (not cash in hand), in SGD.

totalDeductions.description: Everything deducted from the selling price: loan redemption, CPF refunds, agent fees, legal fees and miscellaneous costs, in SGD.

title: Sales proceeds calculator
